question: Under what condition is the state of beast-hood said to arise for one addressed as goddess and lady of the gods?
premises: An addressee is named by two titles.
A state designated as beast-hood is mentioned as object.
That state is characterized as conditioned by ignorance.
inference: Conditioned by ignorance, one so addressed comes to the state of beast-hood.
uncertainties: The agent of attaining beast-hood is not explicitly named.
plain_english: O goddess, O lady of the gods, conditioned by ignorance, one attains beast-hood.
